issues.detail: Rule condition includes train_valid==1 && train_mispredicted==0, but spec says training takes precedence over prediction for GHR; non-mispredict training should not update GHR from prediction.
issues.spec_evidence: When this happens, training takes precedence, because the branch being predicted will be discarded anyway.

issues.detail: Spec says recover GHR to state immediately after mispredicting branch, but contract does not define whether train_history is that state or pre-branch state; example only checks zero.
issues.spec_evidence: recover the branch history register to the state immediately after the mispredicting branch completes execution.
issues.alternative: GHR becomes train_history (given state after branch) versus GHR becomes {train_history[5:0], train_taken}.

issues.detail: Spec does not define 2-bit counter update direction/limits; contract omits counter transition semantics.
issues.spec_evidence: Update the pattern history table (PHT) to train the branch predictor to predict this branch more accurately next time.
issues.alternative: On taken increment saturating at 3, on not-taken decrement saturating at 0; prediction taken iff counter>=2.

issues.detail: Rule condition requires same PHT index but does not specify how to determine same index when train_history differs from current GHR; spec only says same PHT entry.
issues.spec_evidence: If training and prediction of the same PHT entry happen at the same time, the prediction sees the PHT state before training
issues.alternative: Same index computed using train_pc xor train_history for training and predict_pc xor current GHR for prediction.

issues.detail: Rule claims predict_history is GHR used for prediction, but spec S08 says state of branch history register used; contract does not state whether output is pre-update GHR or post-update.
issues.spec_evidence: produces the predicted branch direction and state of the branch history register used to make the prediction.
issues.alternative: predict_history outputs current GHR before predicted-branch update versus after update.

issues.detail: Rule is marked uncertain and spec does not define outputs when predict_valid=0; example assumes zero.
Reset rule lists predict_taken/predict_history outputs but does not specify reset values for internal ghr and pht; states say update_during_reset true but no reset values.

Spec timing diagram S16/S17 not explicitly derived; contract example R7 uses pc=0, train_pc=0, history=0 and expects predict_taken=0, consistent with initial zero PHT but does not demonstrate pre-train visibility after a nonzero counter.
issues.spec_evidence: The training request at cycle 4 changes the PHT entry state in cycle 5, but the prediction request in cycle 4 outputs the PHT state at cycle 4, without considering the effect of the training request in cycle 4.
